label: PF Backlog 196
title: Backend: media ingest + segmentation/tiling + asset store
body:
## Problem / why Large media (e.g. a 5MB image, long audio, video) cannot be fed as-is; media is not tokenized by bytes. There is no ingest/normalize/split layer nor an asset store. ## Goal Ingest media -> normalize -> TILE images / segment audio / frame-sample video -> per-asset summaries; store assets with ids and reuse the text map-reduce for large sets. ## Acceptance criteria - Given a large image/video/audio, the pipeline splits intelligently (tiles/segments/frames) and merges results. - Every asset has a stable id + metadata (codec/res/duration) in the asset store. ## Data model - New asset store (single writer) under products/

/; register in store-registry.json. ## Verification / test plan - Ingest a video: frames sampled + audio extracted + per-asset summary produced.

dashboard_impact.reason: Has a dashboard surface (see paired item).
